message: Act now: DHC-A has 51 patients queued, TAT at 21h (2× median). Escalate to lab supervisor and initiate rerouting immediately.
Redirect MC2-A and CHC2-A referrals to TL2-A now. Expected TAT relief: 14h. Cascade dropout risk is 41% — act before dropout worsens.
Activate CHW follow-up protocol: cascade dropout risk at 56%. Patients are at high risk of being lost to treatment — deploy CHW teams to Chandrapur catchment immediately.
Request +2 technicians from district emergency pool. Redistribute 120 cartridges from TL3-A to DHC-A. Bottleneck will persist without additional staffing.
